WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT cr.raceId, c.country, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM constructorResults AS cr
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count, MIN(record_count) AS min_count
  FROM step1
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT record_count
  FROM step1
  ORDER BY record_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT MIN(record_count) AS min_top10_count
  FROM top10
)
SELECT s.raceId, s.country, s.total_points, s.record_count,
       s.record_count - stats.avg_count AS excess_over_average
FROM step1 AS s
CROSS JOIN stats
CROSS JOIN threshold
WHERE s.record_count > stats.avg_count
  AND s.record_count >= threshold.min_top10_count
ORDER BY excess_over_average DESC
